highlights: Engineered backend services for a speaker publishing and discovery platform, combining ClickHouse lecture queries with MySQL-backed content management, advanced filtering, and pagination.
Optimized lecture discovery using ClickHouse dictionaries, window functions, and batched queries; implemented faceted filters and eliminated N+1 requests in topic-based recommendations.
Built speaker self-service workflows for featured classes, uploads, and banner placements, enforcing resource ownership, premium entitlements, and idempotent asset replacement.
Contributed to migration of a legacy Node.js backend from RethinkDB to MySQL, improving maintainability and supporting production data workflows.
Built a Go exporter that processed 6 million records in 12 minutes, replacing a Node.js process that handled 300,000 records in 16 hours.

Engineered an end-to-end bulk CSV import workflow for leads and ceremony bookings, including automatic field recognition, resilient date parsing, duplicate detection, row-level validation, and transactional creation of records with package defaults.
Architected an embeddable enquiry form that converts website submissions into structured ceremony records, automating client invitations, notifications, and follow-up workflows.
Secured public lead-capture workflows with tenant-scoped package validation, subscription enforcement, server-side validation, and IP/form-based rate limiting.
Extended the SaaS platform to support multiple ceremony types and built configurable template automation, client file uploads, and invitation workflows.
Led development of Ezra, an internal AI tool translating natural-language requests into executable actions.
Designed incident-management workflows with SLA tracking, automated alerts, and structured resolution processes.
Integrated deployment and collaboration services to detect failed builds, create incidents, and update status through Slack.
Developed a containerized e-commerce platform with session management and product caching using Redis.
Optimized server-side caching and frontend product delivery, improving performance and reducing infrastructure overhead.
Improved integration reliability by aligning frontend implementations with shared API contracts and delivered responsive interfaces from Figma designs.
